dataset: CICIDS2017, first 50,000 flows, chronological 80/20 split (10,000 held-out test flows)

alert.scope: second half of the held-out test split; settings (window 10, trigger 20%, hold 30) chosen on the first half

note: The SSM adds about 0.2 points of F1 and no AUC gain. Its role is causal regime context; the alert layer is what turns flow-level flags into incident-level alerts.
